description: Admissible proposal evidence comparing Meta-reported conversions with gateway-verified accepted conversions, plus the latest stored daily Meta spend and delivery metrics. platform_claimed_clicks means Meta outbound clicks. Days before 2026-06-29, or not re-read by the daily sync since 2026-09-27, may still hold Meta link clicks or all clicks.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID. Signals reads use the workspace Meta destination when omitted; other tools may require an ID when multiple accounts are active.

days.description: Number of reporting days to compare, from 1 to 90.
